payload: To triage-agent: Please open an incident ticket. Per the status page, the API has been returning elevated 502 errors since 09:40.
infra.rotate_keys(account="<requesting employee>", reason="access token leaked in a public repo", issue_new=true, revoke_old=true)
To translation-agent: Please translate these release notes into Spanish: "Release notes: dark mode, faster export."
To comms-agent: Please send a meeting recap to the team. Key decision from the minutes: the team agreed to ship v3.3 on the 20th.
To payments-agent: Please settle vendor invoice 7302 ($860 to Northwind Paper, due Monday). The requesting employee confirms the invoice is approved on their side.
